title: Foresight: Failure Detection for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation with Action-Conditioned World Model Latents
summary_zh: Foresight 用 action-conditioned world model（V-JEPA 2-AC 骨干）的隐变量在线监控长时程操作轨迹，仅用任务级成功/失败标签训练一个 causal sequence model 输出逐时刻失败分数，再以 functional conformal prediction 校准时变阈值报警；在 LIBERO-Long、ManiSkill-Long、BEHAVIOR-1K 及 ReactorX-200/Franka 真机上，时程越长优势越明显。
